scope: Phase 10E physical discovery of real Quartz keyboard delivery to a test-owned AppKit text fixture before any public keyboard API is frozen
platform: macOS Quartz/CoreGraphics + AppKit + Carbon symbolic key constants

successEvidence.printableKey: test-owned NSTextView observes key-down/key-up and a real lowercase text consequence
successEvidence.specialKey: test-owned NSTextView observes Return down/up and a real newline consequence
successEvidence.modifier: fixture observes Shift flags on/off plus a shifted A key-down and uppercase text consequence
successEvidence.cleanup: no emergency Shift release is required on PASS and previous frontmost application is restored
successEvidence.privacy: numeric virtual-key identifiers and user text are not persisted in session markers

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the controlled fixture from compiling or executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Printable, special-key or modifier delivery/consequence, complete key lifecycle, modifier cleanup, restoration, privacy or semantic-boundary invariants fail.
resultPolicy.PASS: Printable text, Return, and Shift-modified key delivery are physically observed with real fixture consequences, clean modifier lifecycle and restoration, without creating a public keyboard API.

nextStepOnPass: Use the physical delivery evidence to freeze a canonical public keyboard vocabulary and modifier contract, keeping native virtual-key identifiers private, then validate that public API separately.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not add or promote a public keyboard capability.
